name: Game world
source: A product played as a level: a side-scrolling or top-down world in a limited palette where a small hero walks, jumps and collects the product's features as pick-ups; UI chrome is HUD (score, level bar). Described from the reference reel's pixel and game entries; no sprites or pixels are carried.

frame_device.what: A low-res world (320x180 scaled by an integer) with 3 to 5 parallax layers and a hero sprite; the HUD frame (level number, a progress bar, a counter) stays on screen as the film's clock.
frame_device.moves: The camera scrolls the world whole pixels at a time; the hero walks toward each feature on its own beat, the feature is picked up (flash, counter ticks) and the world palette shifts at act breaks.

ground_motion: Parallax layers drift at different whole-pixel speeds all the time, clouds and stars step on twos, water tiles shimmer; the world is never still between beats.

type.classes: A pixel face (Press Start 2P, Silkscreen or the 3x5 font at 2x to 4x) for HUD and the headline; a clean grotesk for the one real claim line so it stays readable.
type.behaviour: Headlines type on with a cursor or drop in as 3x5 blocks at integer scale; a word may blink once; the claim line is a sharp DOM layer, never pixelated.

image.treatment: One palette (8 to 32 colours) for everything; Codex sprite sheets sliced and snapped to the palette; product UI appears as a screen plate on a sharp layer inside a pixel frame, not pixelated.
image.behaviour: Sprites animate on twos; the world moves by whole pixels; nothing is smoothed or scaled by a fraction.

transitions: iris wipe to the next level (RasanPixelWorld.transition iris)
mosaic or shatter into pixels and re-assemble as the next scene
palette shift from day to dusk to night
level-clear card then a blinds wipe

techniques.name: Level scroll
techniques.what: The world scrolls past a hero that walks in place, and features appear as set pieces along the way.
techniques.route: RasanPixelWorld.layers + tilemap driven by RasanPixel.camera(T*speed, 0) inside RasanPixel.bind; hero.draw on RasanPixelWorld.frameAt(T, {fps: 8, count: 4}).

techniques.name: Feature pick-up
techniques.what: The hero grabs an icon that stands for a feature; it flashes, the counter ticks and the feature's real UI appears.
techniques.route: Sprite jumps on a 3-frame arc (hold twos); item sprite scales 1 to 1.4 for 2 frames then vanishes; the HUD counter steps; a sharp UI plate pops in beside it with RasanShape.squash.

techniques.name: Palette act break
techniques.what: Day turns to dusk to night in steps and the mood of the story turns with it.
techniques.route: RasanPixelWorld.shiftPalette(S, [{at, colors: DAY}, {at+4, colors: DUSK}, {at+8, colors: NIGHT}], T) over the same indices; steps 6, each held >= 0.5 s.

techniques.name: Sprite-sheet act
techniques.what: A Codex-drawn character plays walk, point, react and celebrate from a sliced sheet.
techniques.route: RasanPixelWorld.sheet(img, {cols, rows, size: [24, 24], chroma: '#00ff00', palette: S.palette}) after img.decode(); frameAt per animation row; flip for direction.

techniques.name: Pixel title card
techniques.what: A chunky title drops in at integer scale with an outline and shadow.
techniques.route: RasanPixelWorld.bigText(S, str, x, y, i, {scale: 3, outline: 0, shadow: 2, reveal: p}) with p from RasanPixelWorld.progress(T, at, 0.6, 12).

techniques.name: Boss reveal
techniques.what: The problem is a big sprite that fills half the screen and is defeated by the product's move.
techniques.route: Large sprite built from RasanPixelWorld.sheet at size [64, 64]; hit flashes swap palette indices (draw option swap) for 2 frames; shake the camera by 2 px on twos.

techniques.name: Voxel world cut
techniques.what: A cut to a 3D block diorama that rises, the pixel world's 3D cousin.
techniques.route: Rasan3D stage with the voxel-diorama recipe: camera from recipe.camera(opts); build(k) rises the columns; cut to it with a mosaic transition.

techniques.name: Level-clear bar
techniques.what: A progress bar fills as each rung of the story lands and ends on LEVEL CLEAR.
techniques.route: S.rect for the bar fill, stepped to whole pixels by RasanPixel.hold(T, 12); bigText for the label.

techniques.name: Word choreography
techniques.what: Each word of a line enters from its own place and settles into the line with a lift; the key word last with a little more overshoot.
techniques.route: RasanShape.split(el, {by: 'words'}) on the sharp claim line; each word from its own offset (24 to 80 px), scale 0.88 to 1.15, 0.55 s, stagger 0.09 s, last word back.out(1.4); pixel headlines use typeOn instead.

signature: The hero reaches the final feature, the level clears, and the world freezes on one still pixel frame with the product claim set sharp over it.

density.note: A new pick-up, palette state or camera move every 0.9 to 1.6 s; layers at the peak: 5 to 8 (sky, far, mid, tiles, hero, item, HUD, claim).

palette.note: A brand palette maps onto the limited palette through nearest(); the devices stay.

do: Keep one palette and integer scale for the whole film
Move every pixel layer by whole pixels from one rounded camera
Step sprites on twos and keep the claim line sharp
Let the HUD be the clock of the film
Make each feature a pick-up the hero physically reaches
dont: Do not smooth, blur or fractionally scale the pixel layer
Do not pixelate the real product UI and call it readable
Do not copy any real game's sprites, fonts or melodies
Do not repeat the same transition twice in a row
